_meta.source: Minervini SEPA method + Indian Market Adaptations
_meta.notes: All thresholds are MINIMUM requirements unless marked MAX. Scores are 0-100. Verdict thresholds: BUY>=70, HOLD>=45, SELL<45

trend_template._description: Minervini's Trend Template - all 8 conditions must be TRUE for a valid setup

eps_growth._description: EPS growth must be accelerating, not decelerating

roce._description: Return on Capital Employed - important for Indian capital-intensive businesses

debt_to_equity._description: Lower is better. Finance sector stocks excluded from this rule.

promoter_holding._description: Indian market specific - promoter pledge is a red flag

promoter_holding_trend._description: Decreasing promoter stake is bearish signal

pe_ratio._description: Do not overpay. PE should not be more than 50% above sector median.

revenue_visibility._description: Order book or recurring revenue must be >= 2 quarters visible

management_credibility._description: Management credibility score based on guidance commitments met

moving_averages._description: We use SMAs as per Minervini's original template

volume._description: Breakout must be on 40%+ above average volume to be valid

rsi._description: RSI between 50-80 is the sweet spot for momentum stocks

macd._description: MACD line crossing above signal line is bullish

vcp_pattern._description: Volatility Contraction Pattern - Minervini's signature setup. Contraction in both price range and volume.

pivot_point._description: Buy within 5% of pivot breakout point. Do not chase beyond 5%.

support_levels._description: Never risk more than 7% below entry point (hard stop-loss rule)

relative_strength._description: Relative strength line should be within 15% of its 52-week high (outperforming Nifty)

macro_filters._description: Market environment checks before any trade. If market is in Stage 3/4 decline, reduce position size or stay cash.
macro_filters._india_vix_note: If VIX > 22, reduce position size by 50%. If VIX > 30, no new positions.
macro_filters._description2: Prefer accumulation when RBI is in rate-cut or pause cycle

position_sizing._description: Risk-based position sizing. Never risk more than 1-2% of total portfolio on a single trade.

stage_analysis._description: Weinstein Stage Analysis - only buy in Stage 2 uptrend
stage_analysis.BUY: Stage 2 (price above rising 30-week MA, increasing volume)

sell_rules._description: When to sell - must obey at least one of these
